synth.notes:
Ring+beam move vertically by 6, carrying blocks that overlap the old beam rect; the new beam and ring rects push other blocks (push chain). If any block would leave the colour-4 field, the whole move is cancelled.
A4/A3 change beam width by 6 (A4 is a no-op at the field's right edge). A block of any tag sitting on the beam rows at x == end-5 is hooked, and every block fully on the beam then follows the tip as a chain (this fixes step 87). With no hook, extend pushes the swept 6-col strip and retract moves nothing. If a moved block would leave the field, the beam changes alone.
Tags: if next is hooked and every other on-beam block is collected, next becomes collected and the first todo block in legend order becomes next. A collected block that is off the beam reverts to next, and the current next becomes todo. Legend swatch centre 2x2 is 0 while collected.
